title: Transported inverse-image constants are native constant coefficient modules
statement:
theorem relativeFiniteConstantModelIdentification {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (V : proEtaleSiteModel Y) :
    Nonempty (((relativeFiniteModelModules g B).obj
        ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g (adicLisseConstantRing X B)).obj
          ((adicLisseConstantModules X B).obj M))).over V ≅
      ((SheafOfModules.constantCoefficientModule
        (proEtaleModelTopology Y) B).obj M).over V)

proof.text: Use the already proved private declaration relativeConstant in Sheaf.Paper.PbcFinitePullbackConstructibility: restricting the inverse-image constant M-module along relativeUnit gives the ordinary constant ModuleCat B sheaf on Y. This is obtained there from the module inverse-image adjunction and uniqueness of left adjoints, with no finiteness hypothesis.

For the AsSmall constant-sheaf comparison, apply unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to its defining adjunctions. Evaluation at the transported terminal object is injective on maps out of a constant presheaf. The AsSmall site-equivalence unit acts by the identity, so the comparison carries the transported sheafification unit to the small-site unit. Cancel its inverse and compose with the inverse constant-ring inverse-image comparison. This proves transportUnit: the coefficient map used by relativeFiniteModelModules sends each small-site constant scalar to relativeUnit on the original site.

Define restriction to constant B-scalars on the small site. Local surjectivity of the constant-ring unit makes this functor fully faithful by restrictHomEquivOfIsLocallySurjective. The module-sheafification unit extends to smallConstantComparisonHom from the ordinary constant ModuleCat B sheaf; its local injectivity and local surjectivity make it an isomorphism. These are explicit proved private helpers in the item module, with no new unproved obligations.

The equation transportUnit makes the identity on additive sections a B-linear isomorphism between smallRestriction after relativeFiniteModelModules and precomposition of relativeRestriction by AsSmall.down. Compose it with the first-step constant comparison, the existing constantSheafSheafCongrIso for ModuleCat B, and smallConstantComparisonHom. Lift the resulting isomorphism through fully faithful smallRestriction, and apply SheafOfModules.overFunctor at V.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules; sites.tex Tag 03A0, lemma-equivalence. Reuses the proved relativeConstant helper of PbcFinitePullbackConstructibility; the scalar normalization and fully faithful lifting are proved here.
